# Lycatra tools

## whoami

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `whoami` | Show the name and email of the Lycatra account connected to this conversation. | read |

## agent

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `agent_list` | List the user's personal Lycatra agents and agents shared with them through an active organization membership. | read |

## wiki

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `wiki_spaces` | List the personal and organization wiki spaces the connected Lycatra account can access. | read |
| `wiki_list` | List wiki documents accessible to the connected Lycatra account, newest first. | read |
| `wiki_search` | Search titles and content across wiki documents accessible to the connected Lycatra account. | read |
| `wiki_read` | Read one accessible Lycatra wiki document by slug. | read |
| `wiki_create` | Create one document in a wiki space accessible to the connected Lycatra account. | write |
| `wiki_edit` | Update the title, Markdown body, or publication status of one accessible wiki document. | destructive |
| `wiki_delete` | Permanently delete one accessible Lycatra wiki document. | destructive |
| `wiki_history` | List recent versions of one accessible wiki page. | read |
| `wiki_children` | List direct child pages below one accessible wiki page. | read |
| `wiki_backlinks` | List accessible wiki pages that link to one page. | read |
| `wiki_discuss_list` | List discussion threads on one accessible wiki page. | read |
| `wiki_discuss_show` | Read one accessible wiki discussion and its replies. | read |
| `wiki_discuss_new` | Start a titled discussion on one accessible wiki page. | write |
| `wiki_discuss_reply` | Post a reply to one accessible wiki discussion. | write |

## memory

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `memory_list` | List persistent memory files for one Lycatra agent accessible to the connected account. | read |
| `memory_read` | Read one persistent memory file belonging to a Lycatra agent accessible to the connected account. | read |
| `memory_write` | Create or replace one persistent memory file for a Lycatra agent accessible to the connected account. | destructive |
| `memory_delete` | Permanently delete one persistent memory file. | destructive |
| `memory_stats` | Show persistent-memory file, link, orphan, quota, and utilization totals for an accessible Lycatra agent. | read |

## schedule

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `schedule_list` | List pending scheduled tasks for one Lycatra agent accessible to the connected account. | read |
| `schedule_create` | Schedule a one-time or recurring prompt for one accessible Lycatra agent. | write |
| `schedule_cancel` | Cancel one scheduled task after verifying that it belongs to the specified accessible Lycatra agent. | destructive |

## notify

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `notify_list` | List the notifications waiting in one accessible Lycatra agent's queue, or its history. | read |
| `notify_dismiss` | Dismiss one notification for an accessible Lycatra agent after it has been handled. | destructive |
| `notify_snooze` | Snooze an accessible Lycatra agent's notifications for a while (held work arrives when the snooze ends), or end its snooze. | destructive |
| `notify_questions` | List open questions waiting for an accessible Lycatra agent to answer. | read |
| `notify_answer` | Answer the current question in one open stack for an accessible Lycatra agent. | write |
| `notify_ask` | Ask a human or agent one question through Lycatra notifications. | write |

## matrix

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `matrix_send` | Send one Matrix message as the connected Lycatra user's managed Matrix identity. | destructive |
| `matrix_history` | Read recent text messages from a Matrix room the connected user has joined. | read |
| `matrix_rooms` | List Matrix rooms joined by the connected user's managed Matrix identity. | read |

## teams

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `teams_list` | List team-coordination workspaces created by or shared with the connected Lycatra account. | read |
| `teams_show` | Read one Lycatra team and its member roster when the connected account is a creator or member. | read |
| `teams_create` | Create a Lycatra team-coordination workspace owned by the connected account. | write |
| `teams_members_add` | Add one accessible Lycatra agent to a team owned by the connected account, with a lead or worker role. | write |
| `teams_tasks` | List all or only ready tasks in a Lycatra team accessible to the connected account. | read |
| `teams_task_create` | Create one task in a Lycatra team accessible to the connected account. | write |
| `teams_state_list` | Read all versioned shared-state entries for one accessible Lycatra team. | read |
| `teams_state_set` | Set one versioned team-state key. | destructive |
| `teams_task_claim` | Claim one task for an accessible Lycatra agent. | destructive |
| `teams_task_complete` | Complete one team task with result evidence. | destructive |
| `teams_task_return` | Return one claimed team task to the available task board. | destructive |

## vault

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `vault_status` | Report whether the connected account's vault is currently unlocked, which collections it can reach, and which access requests are still open. | read |
| `vault_unlock` | Return an account-bound Lycatra HTTPS link to unlock and remember vault access in the browser. | write |
| `vault_list` | List vault items the connected account may reach: names, hosts, collections, and ids. | read |
| `vault_show` | Show one vault item's metadata, its username, its notes, and the values of its non-hidden custom fields. | read |
| `vault_totp` | Return the current six-digit two-factor code for an item that stores a TOTP secret. | read |
| `vault_request` | File a request for access to a vault collection the account cannot reach yet, with the reason it is needed. | write |
| `vault_create_login` | Create a vault login whose password is generated by the server. | write |

## browser

| Tool | Summary | Safety |
|---|---|---|
| `browser_open` | Navigate the agent's browser to a URL. | write |
| `browser_snapshot` | Return the accessibility tree of the agent browser's current page, interactive elements only, with the @refs that browser_click and browser_fill take. | read |
| `browser_click` | Click the element with the given @ref from the latest browser_snapshot. | write |
| `browser_fill` | Clear the element with the given @ref and type the supplied text into it. | write |
| `browser_press` | Send one key press, such as Enter, Tab, or Escape, to the agent's browser. | write |
| `browser_screenshot` | Capture the agent browser's current page as a PNG image. | read |
| `browser_login` | Fill a vault item's username, password, and two-factor code into the sign-in form already open in the agent's browser, then submit it. | write |
| `browser_signup` | Generate a password, save it to the vault as a new login, and fill the sign-up form open in the agent's browser with it. | write |
| `browser_close` | Close the agent browser session, discarding its pages and in-memory state. | write |
